---
title: Code block style, dark fill with annotations
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    code-annotations: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrors: default
---

A template sets a dark `fill` in `quarto-code-block-style`.
The annotation circles on the code lines must be light, so they stay visible on the dark background.
The circles in the list below the block keep the text colour.

```{=typst}
#quarto-code-block-style.update(s => s + (fill: rgb("#101010")))
#show circle: it => {
  if type(it.stroke) == stroke and it.stroke.paint == luma(200) { counter("cbs-light").step() }
  it
}
```

```python
x = 1 # <1>
y = 2 # <2>
```

1. First.
2. Second.

```{=typst}
#context assert.eq(counter("cbs-light").final().first(), 2, message: "expected 2 light annotation circles on the dark code block")
```
